content: Publication ggplot2: theme_set() for global default; theme_minimal()/theme_bw() base plus element_text/element_line adjustments for axis labels, margins. Colorblind-safe palettes: Okabe-Ito (8 colors, ggplot2 built-in scale_colour_okabe_ito via ggokabeito), viridis (scale_fill_viridis_d/c). knitr fig.cap chunk option adds HTML/PDF captions; fig.alt for accessibility. For print/PDF: static ggplot2 (not plotly); knitr::is_html_output() guard already in place in EventStudy skeleton.Rmd. Existing EventStudy plotting uses hardcoded 'steelblue', 'red', 'grey40' — not colorblind-safe, no theme_set, no caption system.
